[line]
[size=5][b]Introduction
[/b][/size]
Have you ever rushed back from the Skull Cavern, warped to your farm, sprinted through your front door, and then passed out on your living room rug at exactly 2:00 AM?

[b]Late Night Grace[/b] fixes this by giving you a "second wind" if you have already made it home safely.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40792/40792-1767420161-518561245.png[/img]

[size=5][b]How It Works
[/b][/size]
The mod monitors your time and location late at night.

[list]
At [b]1:50 AM[/b], the mod checks where you are.If you are on your [b]Farm[/b] (outside) or inside your [b]Farm House/Cabin[/b]:[*][]The clock rewinds to [b]1:30 AM[/b].
[*][]You get a notification saying: [i]"Safe at home! +20 mins to sleep."[/i]
[*][]This gives you exactly 20 extra in-game minutes (approx. 14 real-time seconds) to run to your bed.
[*]
If you are [b]not[/b] on your farm (e.g., still in the Mines, Town, or Beach), the mod does nothing, and you will pass out at 2:00 AM as usual.[/list]
[color=#ffff00][b]Note:[/b] This effect triggers only [b]once per night[/b]. If you don't make it to bed by the time 2:00 AM hits the second time, you will pass out!
[/color]

[center][youtube]AwQEVmt3taI[/youtube][/center]


[size=5][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[]Download this mod.
[]Unzip the [b]LateNightGrace[/b] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*][]Works in Single Player.
[*][]Should work in Multiplayer (best if installed by the host and farmhands).
[*][]Compatible with custom farm maps (as long as the game recognizes them as a "Farm").
[/list]
